steps.title: Define Project Specifications
steps.description: Establish package metadata, standard Java 8 settings, and standard build properties for the Error Fixer application.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Environment
steps.description: Set up build.gradle matching the fixed runtime configuration environment: Gradle 8.5, AGP 8.3.2, compileSdkVersion 34, and minSdkVersion 21 with standard Java 8 compatibility.

steps.title: Develop Android Manifest Configuration
steps.description: Design the system manifest including namespace declarations, hardware access diagnostics, network permissions, custom light material theme, and setup main activity points.

steps.title: Design Application Header & Base Tabs Layout
steps.description: Formulate a sleek horizontal navigation tab structure inside the activity_main layout to alternate dynamically among multiple workspaces.

steps.title: Integrate System Diagnostics Interface
steps.description: Implement structural cards within the user layout to present device attributes, operating system specifications, heap RAM tracking, and location permission metrics.

steps.title: Formulate Error Dictionary Database List UI
steps.description: Add search functionality and a structured ListView to search and read diagnostic solutions for typical Android deployment errors.

steps.title: Integrate Crash Simulation Workspace UI
steps.description: Embed custom functional triggers to trigger runtime NullPointerExceptions, ArithmeticExceptions, and Custom exceptions safely to demo uncaught exception handling.

steps.title: Initialize MainActivity Context Lifecycle
steps.description: Establish the main runtime activity package mapping for com.errorfixer.app and set up basic binding for components and system views.

steps.title: Code View Switching Mechanics
steps.description: Program standard visual switching controls to hide and show diagnostics, help encyclopedia lists, and simulation tabs dynamically on user selection.

steps.title: Implement System Hardware Information Evaluators
steps.description: Construct query blocks in Java to extract the active device build name, target Android SDK API, brand names, and allocated JVM memory parameters.

steps.title: Code Active Network Connection Validator
steps.description: Write ConnectivityManager inspectors to diagnose internet state, network medium, and feedback visual color state elements to the client.

steps.title: Incorporate Runtime Location Permissions Request Flow
steps.description: Incorporate run-time validation checks for platform target SDK rules, enabling manual runtime permission flow triggers.

steps.title: Create Common Error Encyclopedia Data
steps.description: Write and feed comprehensive dictionary entries on namespaces, OSM 418 tile blockages, Gradle mismatches, and theme failures into list objects.

steps.title: Implement List Filter Search Core Logic
steps.description: Develop TextWatcher listeners tied to the search field to filter the diagnostics list dynamically based on input.

steps.title: Write Custom Global Uncaught Exception Handling Engine
steps.description: Design an elegant error interceptor. On program crashes, save stack traces, bypass standard OS force-closes, and restart our Main activity containing precise troubleshooting diagnostics.

steps.title: Code Sandbox Intent Crash Restarter Dialogue UI
steps.description: Create automated checks on startup to detect crash parameters and display intercepted logs, error locations, and debugging tips to developers.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 Source & Android Standard Compliance
steps.description: Conduct full check ensuring no lambda rules, no androidx, and exact Android Manifest namespace values are fulfilled.

steps.title: Building Error Fixer
steps.description: Run standard Gradle assemble debug task to compile resource libraries, class bindings, and output the diagnostics tool binary.
